subject: Learning candidate readiness doctor
evidence: The real PostgreSQL doctor fixture advanced one candidate from missing profile, evaluation and gate through queued evaluation, completed run, Pass gate and linked Release to Passed
A gate-purpose withdrawal changed the required purpose set to withdrawn and the sole stop reason to PURPOSE_WITHDRAWN
The CLI rejected unknown, duplicate and malformed flags without echoing secrets, and an unavailable database produced a contract-valid bounded diagnostic
The Core result passed CliDoctorLearningResult validation with commandRef null and no invented evidence refs
limits: The doctor observes readiness; it does not build Gate, create Release, assign scope or promote candidates
External evaluation execution, statistical uncertainty and Release Controller orchestration remain open
Production hosting, real governance systems, independent security review and domain acceptance remain outside local engineering completion
